name: Delhi I Can't See You
deck: We have a name. We do not have a start date, a demand, or one action we can point at — and a campaign is exactly those three things.

holes.what: This is a name and nothing else: no start date, no demand, no action we can name. The air situation page already tells readers it is Swechha's campaign on Delhi's air, and the line above this one says so too — so the name is doing work the content cannot back.
holes.unlocks: Three sentences: when it started, what it asks for, and one thing it has done. Until then every mention of it on this site promises more than this row can keep.

holes.what: There is no photograph, because there is not yet an it.
holes.unlocks: Anything at all from a real action.
